description: This Java class implements a command strategy for retrieving a specific property of a feature within a thing, handling the {@link RetrieveFeatureProperty} command. It involves extracting feature data, retrieving property values, and constructing appropriate results based on the presence of feature and property data.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: Final class implementing a command strategy to handle retrieval of feature properties in a 'thing'. Uses immutable annotation, constructs results based on feature and property existence, and manages entity tags.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the core logic to extract the feature from the 'thing', retrieve its property, and construct a result based on success or failure.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a feature from a 'thing' based on the command's feature ID.

methods.name: getRetrieveFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Overloaded method to generate result after retrieving feature properties or specific property data and create corresponding success or error responses.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag associated with the command, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the next entity tag for the feature property based on the new 'thing' state.
